name: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog
scope: Published genome-wide association results with ontology-annotated traits, study and ancestry tables.
mapping_methods: Variants mapped to Ensembl genes by distance/within-gene rules; coordinates on current assembly (GRCh38 not confirmed from the evidence retrieved).

quantitative.summary: Effect size (beta or OR), CI, p-value, risk allele frequency.

licence.name: EMBL-EBI general terms of use; summary statistics CC0 unless otherwise stated

coverage_limitations: Lead associations rather than causal variants; ancestry bias towards European cohorts
known_omissions: Full summary statistics are in a separate repository

reuse_decision.rationale: Open Targets integrates GWAS Catalog studies into credible sets; the flat associations table is small and fetched for direct lookups. The flat studies.tsv was fetched first and discarded: it has no study accession column; the associations file carries STUDY ACCESSION.

status.notes: FTP listing verified; web REST API root URL guessed incorrectly (404) and not needed.
